text:
Maya K: Heads-up — we should cut a tiny hotfix for 2.6.1. Seen a narrow regression where kv-cache eviction + bursty requests can toss 503s for ~30s. Low blast, but customer impact on retries. Can we do a minimal patch (one-line behavioral tweak + test) and roll this by EOD if approvals are quick?

Samir Patel: I can review. Do we have a repro + unit test? also what's the cutoff time we want to target? :eyes:

Maya K: There's a small repro in the ticket (link pasted in thread). I already added a unit test that repros the race. Goal: minimal diff, bump patch to 2.6.1, changelog line under "Fixes". Target cutoff 18:00 UTC ideally, so we can smoke in the 18:30 window.

Lucas Chen: 18:00 UTC works for me. If Samir can approve, I'll run the canary. Any objections to doing canary on a single dedicated pool first? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Samir Patel: single pool canary sounds good. quick checklist: PR, one-line changelog, add smoke run checklist, CI green. I can do review + approval once PR is up.

Anya R: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/r/5421 - small change in kvcache eviction ordering, adds test, updates CHANGES.md. Commands I ran locally: ```git checkout -b fix/kv-evict-2.6.1
# make change
git commit -am "fix(kvcache): avoid race on eviction causing 503s"
git push origin fix/kv-evict-2.6.1
gh pr create --title "fix(kvcache): avoid eviction race (2.6.1)" --body "minimal patch for eviction race causing transient 503s" --base release/2.6.x
```

DeployBot: New PR r/5421 created by Anya R on branch fix/kv-evict-2.6.1. CI triggered. :robot_face:

Lina (QA): I can take smoke once canary is up. Will run the kv-consistency and latency smoke scripts, ~15m. Please post canary pool and tag so I can watch.

CI Bot: r/5421 — all checks passed (unit, lint, integration). Build artifacts available.

Samir Patel: Reviewing now. Quick nit: can you add one bullet to CHANGES.md with scope and customer impact? e.g., "Fix: avoid short 503s under high eviction pressure (regression)". Also confirm no config changes required.

Anya R: Updated CHANGES.md in PR and added the one-line. No config changes. I also pushed a small commit to pin the patch-level test timeout to avoid flakiness: ```git commit -am "test: pin timeout for kv eviction repro" && git push```

Maya K: Awesome. Once Samir approves, Lucas please kick off canary to pool "dedicated-rail-1" and tag canary as 2.6.1-rc1. Lina, ping here when smoke done.

Lucas Chen: Canary started on dedicated-rail-1, tag 2.6.1-rc1. Watch logs: https://logs.internal/canary/5421.

Lina (QA): Smoke passed (kv-consistency OK, latencies normal). No 503 repro during 20m run. :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: Approved and added :shipit:. Small comment on a test assertion but optional. Merging now.

DeployBot: PR r/5421 merged into release/2.6.x by Samir Patel. CI created build artifact v2.6.1-rc1.

Maya K: I'll cut the patch tag and release after verifying packaging. Plan: tag v2.6.1, create release notes (CHANGES.md line included), push to staging, monitor for 30m, then promote. Any objections?

Anya R: No objections. Happy path confirmed.

Lucas Chen: I'll monitor the rollout and escalate if anything odd.

CI Bot: Release pipeline completed for tag v2.6.1-rc1, all integration smoke passed.

Maya K: Tagging v2.6.1 now and promoting to staging. Will post final status. :rocket:

Maya K: Update — promoted to staging, initial metrics look good. Will hold for 30m then promote to prod unless we see regressions.

Lina (QA): 30m smoke on prod staging looks clean. No regressions observed.

Maya K: Promoting to prod. Thanks all — small, focused change, minimal diff as intended. Adding a changelog nudge to release notes and closing the ticket. :tada: 

Samir Patel: Nice teamwork. :clap:

DeployBot: Release v2.6.1 published.

CI Bot: Final pipeline passed for v2.6.1. Artifacts archived.

Maya K: Closing thread — feel free to reopen if anything pops.
